title: NY RE Exam - Quiz Results
prompt:
iPhone screen 393x852 for a personal NY Real Estate Salesperson exam prep PWA. Dark OLED canvas #090d16, surfaces #111725 and #182033, ink #f1f5f9, secondary ink #a3b1c6. Design language "Wayfinding": New York transit signage. Headings in Helvetica Neue bold, tight tracking, sentence case. Every syllabus topic is a route bullet: a 26px colored circle with a bold 1-character code, always next to the topic name. Route colors are topic identity only (red #DA291C codes 1 2 3, green #00843D codes 4 5 6, blue #0039A6 codes A C E, orange #FF6319 codes B D F M with dark text, yellow #FCCC0A codes N Q R W with dark text, purple #9B2A92 code 7, lime #6CBE45 code G with dark text). Status colors: go #10b981 (correct, at or above the 70% pass line), stop #ef4444 (wrong, below 70%), caution #f59e0b (flagged), statute indigo #818cf8 only for legal citations. Radius 24 for hero sheets, 18 for cards, 14 for controls, full pills for chips and bullets. 16px gutters, 20px between sections. Elevation by surface lightness, no drop shadows except the floating tab bar. Numbers tabular, Helvetica Neue bold. Do NOT use all-caps eyebrow labels, middle-dot separated meta strings, or arrows inside buttons. Avoid a stack of identical cards: vary density and grouping.

Screen: quiz results, shown right after a quiz ends. No tab bar on this screen.
Header: compact large title "Results" (28px) with a one-line subtitle naming the quiz and its mode, e.g. "Mock exam, exam mode".
Hero sheet (radius 24): a huge left-aligned score "64%" (64px bold tabular) with a verdict pill beside it reading "FAIL" in stop red (or "PASS" in go green). Under the score, a horizontal transit line from 0 to 100: a 4px track filled up to the score, with a station marker at 70% labeled "Pass line 70%" so the gap to passing is visible. Then a row of three small stats with the label above the value: "Correct 48 of 75", "Answered 70", "Time 41:12".
Section "By topic": one row per topic in the quiz: route bullet, topic name, right-aligned "3/4", and a thin 4px bar under the name, green when at least 70%, red when below. Example topics: red 2 Law of agency, green 4 Finance, blue E Contracts, yellow Q Closing, orange B Land use, purple 7 Condos and co-ops.
Section "Review": every question as an expandable row. Collapsed row: a 24px round status mark (green check for correct, red cross for wrong), the question number, and the question text clamped to two lines. Show one row expanded: "Your answer" option row tinted red, "Correct answer" option row tinted green, then a citation drawer: surface panel with a 3px indigo #818cf8 left rule and the statute citation in indigo (e.g. "RPL 443"), followed by a two-sentence explanation in secondary ink.
Bottom: thumb-zone action bar docked to the bottom above the home indicator, replacing the tab bar: one dominant go-green 56px button "Retest 27 missed" taking two thirds of the width and a quiet secondary button "Home".
